comment: Both components direct countries to contribute implementation experience back to WHO governance processes, but no concrete channel is named. Experience shows the loop works when a channel exists: execution-level findings against smart-immunizations filed via the IG's public repository (issue #138 with fix PR #139, Aug 2026) demonstrate implementation-to-WHO feedback functioning at artifact level.
